key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; oil 'exploded' as price suppression failed
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut path
ANZ.AX restructuring 3,500 jobs under new chief; long runway to profitability
Housing: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment resilient; no spring auction bounce
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital stress in junior sector
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy-security fears (Santos.AX)

sectors.trend: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil surge offsets some energy-mining weakness. Junior miners raising capital (Canaccord-led dash). Gold underperforming ('schmould'). Small-caps PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Iondrive, Aruma, Neurizon showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term downside on iron ore. Energy miners (Santos.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from oil spike. Junior miners face dilution risk from cap raises. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) under pressure.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs in major restructuring. Rising bond yields and rate-rise fears pressure bank valuations. Superannuation policy debate (One Nation 'sugar hit', early-access proposals) creates regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure from rate uncertainty. Superannuation policy shifts could alter fund-flow dynamics. Rising yields support NIM but cap equity multiples.

sectors.trend: Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c. Australia softened gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos.AX preservation highlighted strategic energy policy.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, SSO.AX, XVG.AX benefit from oil spike. Higher fuel costs feed into CPI, complicating RBA path. Gas supply flexibility supports Santos.AX and downstream LNG names.

sectors.trend: Woolworths.WSW breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples. Consumer tax burden rising. Businesses 'fear for their future'. No spring auction bounce signals weak consumer confidence.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Consumer discretionary names under pressure. Defensive staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) relatively resilient but margin compression likely.

sectors.trend: High-end housing prices seeing steepest falls; affordable end resilient. No spring auction bounce. Property chiefs calling for more migrants. NZ five-year correction still running. High-yield advertising REIT raised dividend 3%+.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals. Housing correction at top end may spill into commercial. Advertising REITs showing resilience. First-home-buyer surge supports long-term demand.

sectors.trend: ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. HIVE scaling AI cloud via BUZZ HPC. OpenAI agent security breach (Hugging Face hack). Critical Resources battery tech passing month-long test.
sectors.implications: Speculative small-caps showing momentum but high volatility. AI/tech names (HIVE.AX) gaining enterprise traction. Cybersecurity risk elevated post-Hugging Face incident.

key_themes: Oil price surge and fuel cost inflation pressuring RBA rate-cut timeline
Iron ore structural decline hitting ASX heavyweight miners
AUD weakness on growth scare amplifying import costs
Housing bifurcation: luxury crash vs affordable resilience
Superannuation policy debate creating regulatory overhang for banks
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises and dilution risk
Energy security policy shift (gas supply rules) supporting domestic producers
Consumer squeeze: tax burden, fuel costs, and price-freeze breaches

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike driving inflation and delaying RBA rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour rate-sensitive defensives; monitor RBA commentary on rental vs headline inflation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price 'bloodletting' compressing mining margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into energy miners and gold on relative value

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness amplifying import costs and equity outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid high-import-cost exposure; monitor AUD/USD 0.62 support

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing correction spilling from luxury to broader market
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor auction clearance rates; underweight construction and mortgage brokers; watch first-home-buyer data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Superannuation policy disruption (One Nation, early-access proposals)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor political risk; favour banks with diversified revenue; avoid over-concentration in super-dependent funds

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining cap-raise wave diluting junior shareholders
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid pre-announcement junior miners; favour cash-flow-positive producers; monitor Cancorp-led raises

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy miners and LNG names on oil spike and gas supply policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; Australia softened gas rules supporting domestic producers; Santos preservation signals policy tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to small-cap miners with proven reserves (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka)
opportunities.rationale: ASX runners showing relative strength; gold-silver exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offers optionality if gold stabilises

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive consumer staples with pricing power
opportunities.rationale: Consumer squeeze intensifying but staples maintain volume; advertising REITs raising dividends signal resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore-heavy mining exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; structural demand concerns from China; cap-raise dilution risk in juniors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate-rise risk via short bond yields or AUD puts
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; oil-driven inflation may delay RBA cuts; bond yields rising

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight luxury housing and construction; monitor for contagion to mid-market
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest falls at top end; no spring auction bounce; NZ correction still running; risk of broader spillover

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil-driven inflation keeps RBA on hold or hawkish, capping rate-cut expectations. Iron ore weakness drags miners. AUD weakness adds import-cost inflation. Expect volatility around RBA statements and oil prints. $90bn weekly loss suggests further downside unless oil stabilises.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and RBA pivots. Housing correction at luxury end may stabilise by H2 2027. Energy transition (battery tech, critical minerals) offers structural growth. Superannuation policy resolution could unlock bank and fund flows. Key risk: prolonged iron ore weakness and global growth slowdown.
